description: Striker's Hauberk Level 60 Bring the the Carapace of the Old God, 2 Idols of Life, 5 Gold Scarabs and 5 Clay Scarabs to Vethsera inside Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Honored reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest. Requirements: - Carapace of the Old God - Idol of Life x 2 - Gold Scarab x 5 - Clay Scarab x 5 - Brood of Nozdormu:
